row.evidence: The Trade Desk's security page says it 'offers SAML-based SSO to customers who wish to use their own identity provider', but no public page mentions SCIM or user provisioning, and pricing is only via a contact form.
row.notes: New row. No public pricing: the DSP is sold through a partnership contact form. The trust/security page confirms customer SAML SSO with the customer's own IdP but says nothing about SCIM. The Okta OIN app is SWA only. Developer/API docs live in the Partner Portal (partner.thetradedesk.com), a JavaScript app that returned only the title 'Partner Portal' to curl/WebFetch and refused the headless renderer (ERR_TOO_MANY_RETRIES), so whether a user-management API or SCIM exists there could not be checked. Status stays unknown rather than none.
